sources.name: ArchDaily
sources.summary: Situated on one of the most singular plots of land in Rio de Janeiro's South Zone, the Epitácio building overlooks the Rodrigo de Freitas Lagoon, making the surrounding environment the protagonist of the design. Developed by Cité Arquitetura, the residential building translates a contemplative and fluid atmosphere into architecture, inspired by the passage of time and a sensitive relationship with the natural landscape.
